title: Signal: Requirement declared from a direct URL
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index.
limitations: It matches a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
